items.title: Pull 90 days of data
items.text: Search Console, analytics and ad accounts, so you see what actually brings leads.

items.title: Map the funnel
items.text: Visit → lead → call → deal. Find the step that leaks most.

items.title: Fix the biggest leak first
items.text: One change, measured for two weeks, beats ten untested ones.
